title: Owner presence, SLA and notifications (tmux, fake time, loopback channel): an owner ask wakes the watcher once at its PT deadline and an unreadable one at once; present caps queue the next build; a recorded away entry gives full caps, still after its until passed, and its words lift no hold; a quiet entry keeps present caps, so busy builders drain without a kill and the oldest queued build is admitted only when they finish; the Slack notifier queues only while away or quiet, retries a refused delivery, never resends an uncertain one, dedupes a replay, refuses and never prints the webhook, and after the owner's return cancels pending messages, reports each delivery outcome and queues nothing new

steps.name: up-ask-deadline-wakes-once-unreadable-at-once
steps.run:
C="python3 {source}/scripts/crew"; O={state_dir}/org-a25.toml; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT --org-profile $O"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; H={state_dir}/hook; A=$G/api---paginate---slurp.json; R=campaign/sandbox-{run_id}
export CAMPAIGN_WEBHOOK="http://127.0.0.1:$(cat $H/port 2>/dev/null || echo 9)/hook/SECRET-T0KEN-a25"
eq() { [ "$1" = "$2" ] || { echo "want: $2"; echo " got: $1"; exit 1; }; }
rec() { python3 {state_dir}/rec.py $A "$@"; }
iso() { python3 -c "import sys,time; print(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(time.time()+int(sys.argv[1]))))" $1; }
caps() { $C schedule decide --pool builder $P > $S/d.json || exit 1; $C schedule summary $P | sed -n 's|^schedule: \(builders [0-9]*/[0-9]*\) .*|\1|p'; }
dj() { python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(' '.join(['%s:%s' % (k, a['ref']) for k in ('admit', 'deferred') for a in d[k]] + ['held:' + h['ref'] for h in d['held']]))" $S/d.json; }
alive() { $C status $P | grep -cE "^builder-[0-9]+ .* alive"; }
ev() { python3 -c "import json,sys; k,i=sys.argv[1:3]; e=dict(id=i, kind=k, url='https://example.invalid/campaign/sandbox-{run_id}/issues/9', title='Keep #7 on hold?', deadline='2026-11-07T09:00:00-08:00', default='keep hold') if k == 'ask' else dict(id=i, kind=k, url='https://example.invalid/campaign/sandbox-{run_id}/pull/' + i, title='Land #' + i, train='direct', milestone='M1'); e.update(json.loads(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else {}); json.dump(e, open('{state_dir}/ev.json', 'w'))" "$@" && $C notify $P --event-file {state_dir}/ev.json 2>&1 | tee -a $H/out.log; }
nfy() { python3 -c "import glob,json,sys; print(' '.join(sorted('%s:%s:%d' % (r['kind'], r['status'], r['failures']) for r in (json.load(open(p)) for p in glob.glob(sys.argv[1] + '/notifications/*.json')))))" $S; }
posts() { cat $H/posts.jsonl 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '; }
due() { python3 -c "import glob,json,sys; [json.dump(dict(r, next=0), open(p, 'w')) for p in glob.glob(sys.argv[1] + '/notifications/*.json') for r in [json.load(open(p))] if r['status'] == 'pending']" $S; }
mode() { echo $1 > $H/mode; }
mkdir -p $G $H $S/asks && echo [] > $G/pr-list.json && echo [] > $G/issue-list.json && echo '[{"number": 7, "labels": [{"name": "crew:hold"}]}]' > $G/issue-list-label-crew:hold.json && echo '{"defaultBranchRef":{"name":"main"}}' > $G/repo-view.json && echo '[[]]' > $A && : > $H/out.log && mode ok
cat > $O <<'TOML'
[backends.owner-channel]
name = "slack"

[runtime.options]
builders = 3
present_builders = 1
present_reviewers = 1
load_low = 1000
load_high = 1001
schedule_ramp = 10
schedule_interval = 3600
slack_webhook_env = "CAMPAIGN_WEBHOOK"
slack_digest_interval = 86400
TOML
cat > {state_dir}/rec.py <<'PY'
import json, sys
# Appends one signed coordinator away or away-return record (protocol Owner away mode) to the fake forge's comments.
path, cmd, cid, rec = sys.argv[1:5]
pages = json.load(open(path))
body = ("[Ash/steer] %s\n\n```json\n%s\n```\n\n<!-- crew:v1 role=coordinator pass=steer cmd=%s cmd-id=%s sha=%s "
        "round=n/a verdict=n/a -->\n\n— Ash (Coordinator) · stub · stub") % (cmd, rec, cmd, cid, "a" * 40)
at = "2026-11-06T00:%02d:00Z" % len(pages[0])
pages[0].append({"id": len(pages[0]) + 1, "user": {"login": "<author-login>"}, "created_at": at, "updated_at": at, "body": body})
json.dump(pages, open(path, "w"))
PY
cat > $H/hook.py <<'PY'
import http.server, json, os, sys, threading, time
# Loopback stand-in for the Slack incoming webhook: logs each post's text; mode file: ok, reject (HTTP 500) or hang.
d = sys.argv[1]


class Hook(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        text = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))["text"]
        with open(os.path.join(d, "posts.jsonl"), "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(text) + "\n")
        mode = open(os.path.join(d, "mode")).read().strip()
        if mode == "hang":
            time.sleep(4)
        self.send_response(500 if mode == "reject" else 200)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b"ok" if mode == "ok" else b"no")

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass


server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Hook)
open(os.path.join(d, "port.tmp"), "w").write(str(server.server_address[1]))
os.replace(os.path.join(d, "port.tmp"), os.path.join(d, "port"))
threading.Timer(900, server.shutdown).start()
server.serve_forever()
PY
$C up $P >/dev/null || exit 1
mkdir -p $S/schedule && echo "{\"target\": 5, \"changed\": \"$(iso 0)\", \"starts\": []}" > $S/schedule/target.json
for i in 1 2 3; do $C watch --interval 0.5 --backstop 1 --no-nudge $P >/dev/null || exit 1; done
dl=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d; print((d.datetime.now(d.timezone(d.timedelta(hours=-8))) + d.timedelta(seconds=4)).isoformat(timespec='seconds'))")
echo "{\"deadline\": \"$dl\"}" > $S/asks/9.json; : > $S/wake/queue.jsonl; t0=$(date +%s)
w=$($C watch --interval 30 --backstop 60 --no-nudge $P | head -1); t1=$(date +%s)
echo "ask 9 (PT deadline $dl): '$w' after $((t1 - t0))s"; eq "$w" "ask: 9 deadline $dl"
python3 -c "import datetime as d,json,sys; q=[json.loads(l) for l in open(sys.argv[1])]; at=d.datetime.fromisoformat(q[0]['at'].replace('Z', '+00:00')); assert at >= d.datetime.fromisoformat(sys.argv[2]), (at, sys.argv[2])" $S/wake/queue.jsonl $dl || exit 1
w=$($C watch --interval 0.5 --backstop 1 --no-nudge $P | head -1); echo "next scan: $w"; eq "$w" "backstop: due (nothing in flight)"
eq "$(grep -c '"reason": "ask"' $S/wake/queue.jsonl)" 1
echo '{"deadline": "tomorrow morning"}' > $S/asks/10.json; t0=$(date +%s)
w=$($C watch --interval 30 --backstop 60 --no-nudge $P | head -1); echo "unreadable ask 10: '$w' after $(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))s"; eq "$w" "ask: 10 deadline unreadable"
rm $S/asks/9.json $S/asks/10.json
